name: intellica-web
description: Intellica web system: shared shell (kit), company home, product site template, tools and arc42.

scripts.check: node tools/check.mjs --all && node tools/check-links.mjs && node tools/check-cyber-claims.mjs && node tools/check-cyber-academy.mjs && node tools/check-arch-academy.mjs && node tools/build-ai-business-academy.mjs --check
scripts.test: node tools/test-markdown.mjs && node tools/test-board.mjs && node tools/test-board-api.mjs && node tools/test-cert-api.mjs && node tools/test-pay-api.mjs && node tools/test-code.mjs && node tools/test-level.mjs && node tools/test-agent.mjs && node tools/test-deploy-lib.mjs && node tools/test-cyber.mjs && node tools/test-cyber-academy.mjs && node tools/test-foundations.mjs
scripts.sync: node tools/build-training.mjs && node tools/build-catalog.mjs && node tools/build-cyber-academy.mjs && node tools/build-arch-academy.mjs && node tools/build-ai-business-academy.mjs && node tools/build-consulting.mjs && node tools/build-industries.mjs && node tools/build-course.mjs && node tools/sync-kit.mjs && node tools/prerender.mjs && node tools/manifest.mjs && node tools/assemble.mjs
scripts.gate: npm run test && npm run sync && npm run check
scripts.setup: node tools/doctor.mjs && npm install && npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.verify: npm run gate && npm run test:browser
scripts.training: node tools/build-training.mjs && node tools/build-catalog.mjs && node tools/build-cyber-academy.mjs && node tools/build-arch-academy.mjs && node tools/build-ai-business-academy.mjs
